title: A checked equality assertion ties an unknown value to the requested boolean

ground_truth.statement: A checked equality assertion ties an unknown value to the requested boolean. After it returns the matching true or false consumer is safe.

notes: Clean-room semantic contract derived from the catalog lead, not a copy of its test harness. Runtime controls distinguish successful values from rejected or absent alternatives. This is a behavior comparison, not a recommendation that every precision limitation is product policy. The relational assertion is implemented with an executable equality guard instead of a vendor-specific assertion annotation. Cross-function inference is the measured contract; no claim is made that competitor annotation parsing is required. Pinned-tool observations retained without widening expectations: phpstan: return.type@10; psalm: MixedReturnStatement@10; mago: mixed-return-statement@10. Runtime controls pass. These are measured precision or contract-interpretation disagreements, not assertions that the tool should adopt every tested policy.
